# Wholesale records and research

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/wholesale)

Price and stock research plus the lifecycle of existing wholesale orders.

**Scope:** New order and quote admission is retired. Existing settlement, fulfilment, cancellation and support remain.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `tcg-wholesale`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. The Next.js app and its order, inventory and pricing code remain in source. The app README records the retirement of new admission; older infrastructure descriptions need their own dated verification.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Preserve existing-order behavior when changing shared pricing or stock code. Treat retirement and database-merge runbooks as plans until their own completion evidence is established.
